name: TCIA source policy

rules.default: Evaluate access and licensing for each dataset component; do not classify TCIA as controlled-access by default.
rules.openCreativeCommons: Eligible for educational use subject to the stated licence, attribution and TCIA data-usage requirements.
rules.controlledAccess: Requires the applicable authorization and data-use terms.
rules.mixedCollections: Treat public and controlled components independently according to their individual access rows and licences.
rules.synthetic: High-fidelity synthetic anatomy and pathology are permitted when volumetric anatomical and imaging quality is benchmarked against appropriate TCIA and VSD reference data. Synthetic content must not be represented as a clinical source scan.

qualityRequirements: One volumetric anatomy representation must feed CT and radiographic projection.
Synthetic anatomy must preserve plausible 3D anatomy, HU/attenuation relationships and geometric consistency.
Patient positioning, projection geometry and collimation must alter the resulting radiograph rather than merely crop a final image.
Synthetic pathology must be implemented in the 3D teaching volume or attenuation field, not painted onto the final 2D image.
Low-detail ellipse, stick-figure or cartoon anatomy is not an acceptable production fallback.
